title.narrative: SUPPORT TO THE COMMITTEE ON MISSING PERSONS’ (CMP) PROJECT ON EXHUMATION, IDENTIFICATION AND RETURN OF REMAINS OF MISSING PERSONS IN CYPRUS – MULTI DONOR 2021 - 2026

description.narrative: The project supports the Committee on Missing Persons (CMP) project to recover, identify and return to their families the remains of persons who went missing during the inter-communal fighting of 1963 to 1964 and the events of 1974.
